trials.title: Study With Omecamtiv Mecarbil (CK-1827452) to Treat Chronic Heart Failure With Severely Reduced Ejection Fraction
conditions: Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction
reasons: one of only 5 trials at this company
trials.commentary: Ph 3, randomized, double-blind, treatment. Targeting 1,800 patients. Started Dec 2024, primary completion Sep 2027 (2.7 yrs).

trials.title: A Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Aficamten Compared to Placebo in Adults With Symptomatic Non-Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (nHCM)
reasons: one of only 5 trials at this company
trials.commentary: Ph 3, randomized, double-blind, treatment. Targeting 500 patients. Started Aug 2023, primary completion Aug 2026 (3.0 yrs). Enrollment is closed; the next event is data.

trials.title: A Study to Evaluate the Effect of Aficamten in Pediatric Patients With Symptomatic Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (oHCM).

trials.commentary: Ph 2/Ph 3, randomized, double-blind, treatment. Targeting 65 patients. Started May 2024, primary completion Jan 2030 (5.6 yrs). Enrollment is closed; the next event is data.

trials.title: Phase 3 Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Aficamten Compared to Placebo in Adults With Symptomatic oHCM
